_comment: Receipt for one real SD-Turbo fp32 UNet export (Lab pre-merge gate on PR #378). export_report is the verbatim export_report.json written by export_sd_turbo.py; the other fields come from the same run on the same host. Exporter metadata (pkg.torch.onnx.* stack traces etc.) is stripped before save, so the graphs carry no source paths; metadata_scan records the check. Paths in commands are relative. Peak RSS: ru_maxrss of the child process. Reproduce: diffusion/README.md.

export.command: python diffusion/export_sd_turbo.py --model stabilityai/sd-turbo --revision b261bac6fd2cf515557d5d0707481eafa0485ec2 --components unet --out real-unet --verify

convert_fp16.ort_load: OK at ORT_ENABLE_EXTENDED, inputs sample/timestep/encoder_hidden_states tensor(float16)
convert_fp16.default_path_note: The default ORT path (OnnxModel.convert_float_to_float16 on the fully loaded model) was killed by the OOM killer on this host at about 9969 MiB peak RSS, before the low-memory path existed.

metadata_scan._comment: tests/test_diffusion_export.py::_metadata_leaks over both graphs (no external data loaded): metadata_props and doc_string of the model, graph, every node, attribute, value and initializer, plus home-path patterns in names.
